extracted_content.content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare Local Coverage Determinations (LCD's) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare Local Coverage Determinations (LCD's) as outlined below. In addition to this policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

1. To detect Babesia microti, Nucleic Acid Amplification Tests (NAAT) testing, including Polymerase Chain Reaction (PCR) testing,

(CPT code 87469) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with one of the following symptoms:

2. For individuals with a diagnosis of Babesiosis, the use of either an Immunoglobulin G (IgG) or Immunoglobulin M (IgM) indirect

immunofluorescence antibody (IFA) assay (CPT code 86753) for Babesia IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

1. To detect Borrelia spp., NAAT testing, including PCR testing, (CPT code 87478), an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin G (IgG)

antibodies (CPT code 86619) or detection by immunoblot of Immunoglobulin G (IgG) or Immunoglobulin M (IgM) antibody (CPT code 0043U, CPT code 0044U) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with one of the following symptoms:

1. For individuals with a diagnosis of classical or hemorrhagic dengue fever, the hemagglutination inhibition test (CPT code 86280)

IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

1. To detect Anaplamsa phagocytophilum or Ehrlichia chaffeensis, NAAT testing, including PCR testing, of whole blood (CPT code

87468, CPT code 87484) or an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibodies (CPT code 86666) IS REIMBURSABLE for individuals with one of the following symptoms:

1. The use of an IFA assay for Plasmodium antibodies (CPT code 86750) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

1. The use of an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibodies to Rickettsia (CPT code 86757) IS REIMBURSABLE twice when at

least two weeks has passed between tests and IS ONLY REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following symptoms:

Ulcerative lesion with regional lymphadenopathy for Rickettsia species 364D rickettsiosis

2. For individuals with a diagnosis of typhus fever or Rickettsiosis, blood culture testing (CPT code 87040) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

1. The use of an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin M (IgM) antibodies specific to West Nile virus (CPT code 86788, CPT code 86789) IS

REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following symptoms:

2. For individuals with a diagnosis of West Nile virus infection, the use of an IFA assay for Immunoglobulin G (IgG) antibodies

specific to West Nile virus (CPT code 86789) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

1. NAAT testing including, PCR testing, (CPT code 87662*) or Immunoglobulin M (IgM) testing (CPT code 86794*) for Zika virus IS

REIMBURSABLE for individuals with any of the following symptoms:

1. For asymptomatic individuals, testing for Babesiosis, Borrelia, Dengue virus, Ehrlichiosis and Anaplasmosis, Plasmodium,

Rickettsiosis, West Nile virus or Zika virus with the tests discussed above IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.
